caption: The drawing shows a figure featuring a large, elongated, reddish-brown cone-shaped hat that extends high above the head. The hat is adorned near its base with a decorative, black and gold band. The face is a mask with a wooden texture and is painted in flesh tones with red blush on the cheeks. It has thick black eyebrows, large round yellow and white eyes with black pupils, a large nose, and a wide red mouth displaying prominent white teeth. The mask is dressed in a large, ruffled white collar and what appears to be a yellowish-brown garment visible at the shoulders. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or decorations, and the artist’s signature "E.D. Stzalowski" appears at the lower right corner.
title: Punch's Head
